New Day Summer Camp : 

Dear Mr. Mario,

I hope you are doing well. We are excited to have you work with us for this summer!

As we prepare for our summer program, we are requesting a few items from you to complete our planning and documentation:

* A **quote letter** for your services
* A brief **letter describing your business purpose**
* Details on **what activities or instruction you will be providing for our students**
* The **amount of time you will spend with students on the day selected.**
* The **number of days you will be working with students** between **June 10, 2026 and July 17, 2026**

**I am also attaching a D@F form that needs to be filled out**

[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1y\_qJBxI5qMdL6ih62XtIheIGzER9sVQ-W5kqEPCXZhY/edit?usp\=sharing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1y_qJBxI5qMdL6ih62XtIheIGzER9sVQ-W5kqEPCXZhY/edit?usp=sharing)

Please let us know if you have any questions or need additional information from us. We look forward to working together and providing a great experience for our students.



I'll create a comprehensive summary with an actionable checklist for you:---

## **🎯 Bottom Line**

You have **everything in place** to succeed with this opportunity:

✅ **3+ year proven relationship** with Toderick Moore
✅ **Approved JCPS vendor** with existing contract revenue
✅ **Track record of service delivery** (with documented history of fixing issues)
✅ **Strategic positioning opportunity** for premium pricing ($10K-$100K+ range)

⚠️ **What you need NOW:**

1. **Complete the JCPS D@F form** — this is the gate-keeper. Charles Burns showed you how to win it.
2. **Package your unique value** — XR + LMS + workforce \= rare bundle no one else offers
3. **Submit by deadline** — assume 1-2 weeks from Mar 30 request

The checklist above is your roadmap. Use the positioning strategy to make the case that Tech At Nite is the **only vendor** who can deliver this. Once JCPS approves the no-bid justification, the rest becomes administrative.

**Recommendation:** Start with the D@F form today — that's your leverage point. Would you like me to help you draft any of these documents?

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from textwrap import wrap



W, H \= 2000, 1400

img \= Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (6, 12, 24))

draw \= ImageDraw.Draw(img)



\# Fonts

font\_bold \= "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

font\_reg \= "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

title\_font \= ImageFont.truetype(font\_bold, 56)

sub\_font \= ImageFont.truetype(font\_reg, 28)

section\_font \= ImageFont.truetype(font\_bold, 30)

body\_font \= ImageFont.truetype(font\_reg, 22)

small\_font \= ImageFont.truetype(font\_reg, 18)

tiny\_font \= ImageFont.truetype(font\_reg, 16)



\# Colors inspired by the prior graphic / brand-kit style

BG \= (6, 12, 24)

WHITE \= (240, 246, 252)

CYAN \= (92, 220, 255)

GREEN \= (110, 232, 170)

GOLD \= (255, 206, 94)

BLUE \= (18, 37, 63)

MID \= (24, 50, 82)

PANEL \= (12, 27, 46)

PURPLE \= (148, 116, 255)

ORANGE \= (255, 173, 79)

RED \= (255, 110, 110)

LINE \= (109, 178, 255)



def rounded\_box(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill, outline\=None, width\=3, radius\=22):

    draw.rounded\_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius\=radius, fill\=fill, outline\=outline, width\=width)



def fit\_lines(text, font, max\_width):

    words \= text.split()

    lines \= \[]

    current \= ""

    for word in words:

        test \= (current + " " + word).strip()

        if draw.textlength(test, font\=font) \<\= max\_width:

            current \= test

        else:

            if current:

                lines.append(current)

            current \= word

    if current:

        lines.append(current)

    return lines



def centered\_block(text, box, font, fill\=WHITE, line\_spacing\=6, pad\=12):

    x1, y1, x2, y2 \= box

    lines \= \[]

    for paragraph in text.split("\n"):

        lines.extend(fit\_lines(paragraph, font, x2-x1-pad\*2))

    line\_h \= font.getbbox("Ag")\[3] - font.getbbox("Ag")\[1]

    total\_h \= len(lines) \* line\_h + (len(lines)-1) \* line\_spacing

    y \= y1 + ((y2-y1) - total\_h) / 2

    for line in lines:

        w \= draw.textlength(line, font\=font)

        x \= x1 + ((x2-x1) - w)/2

        draw.text((x, y), line, font\=font, fill\=fill)

        y +\= line\_h + line\_spacing



def left\_block(title, items, box, title\_color\=GOLD, bullet\_color\=GREEN):

    x1, y1, x2, y2 \= box

    rounded\_box(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill\=PANEL, outline\=LINE, width\=2, radius\=24)

    draw.text((x1+18, y1+14), title, font\=section\_font, fill\=title\_color)

    y \= y1 + 58

    for item in items:

        wrapped \= fit\_lines(item, body\_font, x2-x1-50)

        first \= True

        for line in wrapped:

            if first:

                draw.text((x1+20, y), "•", font\=body\_font, fill\=bullet\_color)

                draw.text((x1+40, y), line, font\=body\_font, fill\=WHITE)

                first \= False

            else:

                draw.text((x1+40, y), line, font\=body\_font, fill\=WHITE)

            y +\= 28

        y +\= 8



def role\_card(x1, y1, x2, y2, title, subtitle, color):

    rounded\_box(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill\=BLUE, outline\=color, width\=3, radius\=22)

    centered\_block(title, (x1+10, y1+10, x2-10, y1+55), section\_font, fill\=color)

    centered\_block(subtitle, (x1+15, y1+60, x2-15, y2-12), body\_font, fill\=WHITE)



def small\_card(x1, y1, x2, y2, title, subtitle, color):

    rounded\_box(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill\=PANEL, outline\=color, width\=2, radius\=20)

    centered\_block(title, (x1+10, y1+8, x2-10, y1+40), body\_font, fill\=color)

    centered\_block(subtitle, (x1+10, y1+42, x2-10, y2-10), small\_font, fill\=WHITE)



\# Header

draw.text((60, 40), "H3AT SOLUTIONS", font\=title\_font, fill\=WHITE)

draw.text((60, 108), "Laser Beam Growth & Communication Organization Diagram", font\=sub\_font, fill\=CYAN)

draw.text((60, 145), "Business • Marketing • Sales Management • Human-Centric Agentic Workflow Solutions", font\=sub\_font, fill\=GREEN)



\# Mission and identity

rounded\_box(1420, 30, 1940, 170, fill\=BLUE, outline\=CYAN)

draw.text((1450, 50), "REAL DATA ANCHORS", font\=section\_font, fill\=GOLD)

centered\_block(

    "Company: H3AT Consulting & Development (DBA: H3AT Solutions)\n"

    "Location: Louisville, Kentucky\n"

    "Website: h3atsolutions.com\n"

    "Phone: 502-709-7413",

    (1440, 82, 1925, 160),

    small\_font,

    fill\=WHITE,

)



\# Beam

draw.line((70, 210, 1930, 210), fill\=CYAN, width\=5)

draw.ellipse((990, 195, 1010, 215), fill\=WHITE)



\# Central leadership

rounded\_box(700, 235, 1300, 335, fill\=MID, outline\=GOLD, width\=3)

centered\_block("FOUNDER / STRATEGIC DIRECTION", (715, 248, 1285, 285), section\_font, fill\=WHITE)

centered\_block("Mission, partnerships, enterprise growth, and solution design", (725, 286, 1275, 322), body\_font, fill\=GREEN)



\# Side panels

left\_block(

    "LASER GROWTH FRAMEWORK",

    \[

        "Focus: identify the right markets, clients, and operational pain points",

        "Align: connect humans, agents, systems, and service delivery",

        "Amplify: scale repeatable wins using AI workflows and dashboards",

        "Scale: turn strong execution into durable revenue and partnerships",

    ],

    (40, 260, 430, 760),

    title\_color\=GOLD,

)

left\_block(

    "COMMUNICATION FLOW",

    \[

        "Inform: the right message to the right stakeholder at the right time",

        "Align: shared visibility across business, marketing, sales, and operations",

        "Act: route approvals, follow-ups, tasks, and escalations clearly",

    ],

    (40, 790, 430, 1130),

    title\_color\=CYAN,

    bullet\_color\=CYAN,

)

left\_block(

    "BRAND KIT",

    \[

        "Voice: strategic, human-led, execution-driven, future-focused",

        "Primary colors: Deep Navy, Electric Cyan, Growth Green, Signal Gold",

        "Use cases: decks, dashboards, AMX talent posts, proposals, sales one-pagers",

        "Visual rule: clean structure, bright emphasis, one-message-at-a-time clarity",

    ],

    (1550, 790, 1950, 1220),

    title\_color\=GREEN,

    bullet\_color\=GOLD,

)



left\_block(

    "SALES MANAGEMENT",

    \[

        "Attract: AI-assisted marketing and demand generation",

        "Qualify: route the best opportunities with data and scoring",

        "Present: human-led conversations powered by agent insights",

        "Close: streamlined proposals, approvals, onboarding, and reporting",

        "Grow: customer success, renewals, referrals, and expansion",

    ],

    (1550, 260, 1950, 760),

    title\_color\=GOLD,

    bullet\_color\=GREEN,

)



\# Leadership layer roles based on actual H3AT service areas

cards \= \[

    ("Business Development\n& Infrastructure", "Entity structure, partnerships,\ncontracts, compliance", CYAN),

    ("Strategic Consulting\n& Advisory", "Growth plans, revenue design,\nmarket positioning", GREEN),

    ("AI & Generative AI\nSolutions", "Automation, custom GPTs,\nAI dashboards, insights", PURPLE),

    ("Systems Development\n& Integration", "CRM, databases, APIs,\ncloud and workflow systems", ORANGE),

    ("Communications\n& Client Success", "Messaging, reporting,\nonboarding, retention", GOLD),

]

x\_positions \= \[470, 690, 910, 1130, 1350]

for x, (t, s, c) in zip(x\_positions, cards):

    role\_card(x, 390, x+190, 590, t, s, c)



\# Connect from center

for x in \[565, 785, 1005, 1225, 1445]:

    draw.line((1000, 335, x, 370), fill\=LINE, width\=3)

    draw.line((x, 370, x, 390), fill\=LINE, width\=3)



\# Human + AI layer

rounded\_box(470, 650, 1535, 850, fill\=PANEL, outline\=CYAN, width\=3)

centered\_block("HUMAN + AI AGENT COLLABORATION LAYER", (520, 665, 1485, 705), section\_font, fill\=CYAN)

centered\_block(

    "Humans own judgment, empathy, approvals, and relationship leadership.\n"

    "Agents handle research, drafting, routing, reporting, and workflow scale.",

    (520, 710, 1485, 760),

    body\_font,

    fill\=WHITE,

)



agent\_titles \= \[

    ("Research Agent", CYAN),

    ("Content Agent", GREEN),

    ("CRM & Data Agent", ORANGE),

    ("Sales Assist Agent", PURPLE),

    ("PMO Agent", GOLD),

    ("Support Agent", RED),

]

ax \= 500

for title, color in agent\_titles:

    small\_card(ax, 770, ax+155, 830, title, "Agentic support", color)

    ax +\= 170



\# Connect leadership cards to human+AI layer

for x in \[565, 785, 1005, 1225, 1445]:

    draw.line((x, 590, x, 650), fill\=LINE, width\=3)



\# Pods

rounded\_box(470, 920, 1535, 1250, fill\=BLUE, outline\=LINE, width\=3)

centered\_block("LEAN PODS FOR GROWTH, DELIVERY, AND REVENUE", (540, 935, 1465, 970), section\_font, fill\=WHITE)



pod\_specs \= \[

    ("Growth Pod", "Market strategy,\npartnerships,\nnew opportunities", CYAN),

    ("Demand Pod", "Brand, content,\ncampaigns,\nlead generation", GREEN),

    ("Revenue Pod", "Sales process,\nproposals,\naccount growth", PURPLE),

    ("Delivery Pod", "Implementation,\noperations,\nsupport success", ORANGE),

]

px \= 520

for title, subtitle, color in pod\_specs:

    role\_card(px, 995, px+225, 1185, title, subtitle, color)

    px +\= 250



for x in \[632, 882, 1132, 1382]:

    draw.line((x, 850, x, 995), fill\=LINE, width\=3)



\# Footer band

rounded\_box(470, 1275, 1535, 1350, fill\=PANEL, outline\=GREEN, width\=2)

centered\_block(

    "One mission. One team. One system. Business + marketing + sales + delivery in one beam.",

    (500, 1290, 1505, 1335),

    body\_font,

    fill\=WHITE,

)



out \= "/mnt/data/h3at\_real\_data\_org\_diagram\_brand\_kit.png"

img.save(out)

print(out)
